episodes.title: Full of Love! Cure Whip, Ready to Serve!
episodes.synopsis: When Usami Ichika tries to bake a cake for her mother, she's visited by a helpful fairy and a troublemaking monster! To save her cake, she must transform into the legendary pâtissier, Cure Whip!

episodes.title: The Little Genius, Cure Custard!
episodes.synopsis: Ichika bonds with shy Arisugawa Himari over a mutual love of purin. Though Arisugawa fears her passion for sweets might scare her new friend away, it comes in handy when she transforms into Cure Custard!

episodes.title: Roar, Lion! Cure Gelato!
episodes.synopsis: Ichika and Himari are head-over-heels for the hardcore rocker, Tategami Aoi. But when a monster tries to interrupt her concert, Aoi transforms into the electric Cure Gelato!

episodes.title: Three Girls United! Let's La Mix-It-Up!
episodes.synopsis: The three new best friends decide to bake an extra-special treat for their favorite ballerina. But is the recipe for cream puffs biting off more than they can chew?!

episodes.title: That Capricious Young Lady Is Cure Macaron!
episodes.synopsis: Kotozume Yukari is the most beautiful girl in her school, exceptionally talented... and bored with everything. But when she finds herself taking a liking to Ichika, she winds up as her newest ally, Cure Macaron!

episodes.title: Is This Love?! The Glorious Cure Chocolat!
episodes.synopsis: When kind and dreamy Kenjo Akira moves in next door, Ichika starts to feel things she's never felt before... but after making chocolate together, she's shocked to see her new crush transform into Cure Chocolat!

episodes.title: Pekorin Makes Donuts, Peko!
episodes.synopsis: Reminiscing about her missing fairy friends has Pekorin feeling blue. To cheer her up, Ichika proposes a donut party on the mountain!

episodes.title: The KiraPâti's Opening... Isn't Happening!
episodes.synopsis: Ichika wants her friends to open their own pâtisserie! But as they assign roles and get to work, nothing seems to go right...

episodes.title: The KiraPâti Will Make Your Love Come True!
episodes.synopsis: The KiraPâti is open for business... but nobody's coming! Will baking cookies for a lovelorn young man help to turn their luck around?

episodes.title: Yukari vs. Akira! A Tempestuous Errand!
episodes.synopsis: Akira and Yukari are the stars of the KiraPâti, but when Ichika sends them out to buy toppings for the perfect fruit tart, their natural differences assert themselves.

episodes.title: Showdown! Precure vs. the Gummy Gang!
episodes.synopsis: The KiraPâti has a booth in the town's sweets festival! But Gummy and his gang are back, and they're hungry... for the town's entire supply of kirakiral!

episodes.title: The Enemy Is... the Popular Exchange Student?!
episodes.synopsis: A cool and mysterious transfer student, Kuroki Rio, arrives at Ichika's school. Meanwhile, a new threat arrives to challenge the Precures: the sinister masked Julio!

episodes.title: Can't Do It! Himari's Unexpected Debut!
episodes.synopsis: The local greengrocer thinks Himari is the perfect person to do PR for Ichigozaka Shopping Street! But will her fear of sharing her passion hold her back from it?

episodes.title: Rich Girl Rock 'n' Roll!
episodes.synopsis: Aoi is snatched away in the middle of a concert... by her family butler?! Rock 'n' roll is Aoi's only outlet from her restrictive upbringing, and if Ichika can't help, she might lose it forever!

episodes.title: For the Sake of Love! The Angry Cure Chocolat!
episodes.synopsis: Akira's sister Miku gets a reprieve from the hospital to visit the KiraPâti! While Akira frets about Miku's health, Miku seems desperate to find a way to show her appreciation for Akira.

episodes.title: A Dangerously Sudden Approach! Yukari and Rio!
episodes.synopsis: Yukari invites the girls to a tea ceremony at her traditional home... and sets a trap for Julio!

episodes.title: The Final Experiment! Cure Whip Can't Transform!
episodes.synopsis: Julio sets his manipulative sights on the leader of the Precures: Cure Whip! Can Ichika's love for her mother win the day?!

episodes.title: The Source of the Rumors Is the Powerful Bibli!
episodes.synopsis: While the Precure girls struggle with a nasty rumor about their shop, Master Noir sends a new envoy to rustle up kirakiral in Ichigozaka: the cynical trickster Bibli!

episodes.title: The Pâtissier Prodigy! Kirahoshi Ciel!
episodes.synopsis: Parisian sweets prodigy Kirahoshi Ciel arrives in Ichigozaka, and Ichika is determined to become her disciple!

episodes.title: Admiration Mix-It-Up! Ichika and Ciel!
episodes.synopsis: Ciel decides to give Ichika a lesson in fine ingredients with a trip through the mountains. But a sweet visit to a honey farm is interrupted by a Bibli attack!

episodes.title: Say What?! Ciel's Identity Revealed!
episodes.synopsis: The fairies have returned to Mt. Ichigo! Ichika and the others head there to celebrate, but... wait, why is Ciel there, too?!

episodes.title: Stop It, Julio! The Kirakiral of Hatred!
episodes.synopsis: When Julio returns to vent his hatred on the Precures, Ciel reveals the secret connection they share.

episodes.title: Fly! The Rainbow Pegasus, Cure Parfait!
episodes.synopsis: When Ciel tries desperately to make amends with Julio, she's carried off by Noir... and a new Precure is born!

episodes.title: The Transfer Student Is the Fairy Kirarin?!
episodes.synopsis: Ciel transfers to the girls' school to strengthen their bonds as a team. But the brutish Glaive rolls up in Ichigozaka to steal kirakiral en masse!

episodes.title: A Whirlwind Marriage?! Princess Yukari!
episodes.synopsis: A visiting prince decides to make Yukari his bride, and Yukari seems to entertain the possibility. Akira's objections just end up with her wrapped in the affair... as a rival for Yukari's affections!

episodes.title: Summer! The Beach! The KiraPâti Gets Stranded!
episodes.synopsis: An innocent trip to the beach ends up with the KiraPâti girls stranded on a deserted island! In their quest to find enough kirakiral to get home, they run into an old rival who's just as stuck as they are.

episodes.title: The Hot Live Battle! Aoi vs. Misaki!
episodes.synopsis: Aoi gets her dream: to appear in a rock festival with her idol, Misaki! But can Aoi sing her heart out when the two are pitted against each other?

episodes.title: Rise! Himari's Big Sweets Experiment!
episodes.synopsis: A mysterious professor whisks Himari away to be his assistant in creating history's biggest sponge cake. Will she rise to the challenge, or will her on-stage debut be a flop?!

episodes.title: Emergency! Cure Macaron, Stained in Darkness!
episodes.synopsis: Yukari finds herself feeling pensive over her own capricious personality, and the sinister new foe, Elysio, offers her a window into her soul.

episodes.title: The Targeted School Festival! Chocolat in Wonderland!
episodes.synopsis: When Miku joins the KiraPâti girls at the cultural festival at Yukari and Akira's school, Elysio offers Akira a terrible ultimatum.

episodes.title: Hold Back the Tears! The Reason for Ichika's Smile!
episodes.synopsis: Ichika struggles to be her usual cheerful self when her mother returns home unexpectedly.

episodes.title: Kirakira Sparkle, Six Unique Traits! Kirakiral Creamer!
episodes.synopsis: The girls are sent a hundred years into Ichigozaka's past, where they witness the extent of Noir's evil... and meet the Precure of old!

episodes.title: Sweets Are Dangerous?! The Animal of Darkness Reawakens!!
episodes.synopsis: Noir's most loyal servant, Diable, is sowing discord among the citizens of Ichigozaka... and he's using sweets to do it?!

episodes.title: A Little Grudge Match! Cat Yukari vs. Fairy Kirarin!
episodes.synopsis: In circumstances as capricious as she is, Yukari is turned into a cat! Soon, she finds herself caught up in a turf war between the feral cats and fairies of Mt. Ichigozaka!

episodes.title: Complementary Tastes! Himari and Aoi!
episodes.synopsis: Awkward Himari finds herself questioning her friendship with Aoi while attending a high-society party. But soon, all of the guests are at each other's throats!

episodes.title: Ichika and Akira! The Great Ichigozaka Games!
episodes.synopsis: The annual Ichigozaka Games bring out the competitive spirit in everyone, but the athletic Akira is particularly determined to make a good showing for her neighborhood.

episodes.title: Salut! Ciel's Going Back to France?!
episodes.synopsis: Ciel's sponsor has come all the way from Paris to demand that she return! Can the girls convince the demanding Madame Selene of Ichigozaka's quiet appeal?

episodes.title: Pekorin's a Person, Peko!
episodes.synopsis: Pekorin wakes up one night... to find out she's turned into a human?! Proud to finally get to do things she could never do before, she heads out on her first real errand.

episodes.title: Aw, No! Precure's Enemy Is Ichigozaka?!
episodes.synopsis: While the girls try to convince the other fairy tribes to join their fight against Noir, Glaive returns... with his nastiest trick yet!

episodes.title: Let's la Costume-Change! Sweets Castle, Ready to Serve!
episodes.synopsis: The Precures' efforts to save the citizens of Ichigozaka continue to fail in the face of Glaive's darkness. What can possibly save them?!

episodes.title: Dreams Are Kira-Pika Infinite!
episodes.synopsis: A mysterious kirakiral thief terrorizing Ichigozaka turns out to be Elysio's latest plan to tear Ciel's family apart.

episodes.title: Sing It Out, Wow! Aoi's Last Song!
episodes.synopsis: Aoi struggles to figure out what to do when Wild Azur's leader and lyricist reveals that he has to quit the band.

episodes.title: The Secret Ingredient Is Courage! Himari's Recipe for the Future!
episodes.synopsis: Himari decides to test how much she's changed in the past year by auditioning for a cooking show.

episodes.title: Feelings Hidden in the Snow! Shout Out Your Love, Akira!
episodes.synopsis: When Miku goes missing from the hospital, Akira is driven to desperation searching for her.

episodes.title: Farewell, Yukari! The Thrilling Sweets Christmas!
episodes.synopsis: Yukari makes a rare suggestion: the KiraPâti should host a Christmas party! But an announcement about her future threatens to bring down the merry mood...

episodes.title: The Big Battle with Noir! A Birthday Without Smiles!
episodes.synopsis: With life about to take them in separate directions, the girls decide to hold a birthday party for Ichika.

episodes.title: Return the Love! Cure Pekorin, Ready to Serve!
episodes.synopsis: Elysio's desire for perfect control locks the Precures in a world without love or hate. The only one who can save them is... Pekorin?!

episodes.title: The Final Battle! The Whole World, Let's la Mix-It-Up!
episodes.synopsis: The Precures make one last desperate stand to convince Elysio of the importance of love.

episodes.title: Go Where Love Takes You! Whip, Step, Jump!
episodes.synopsis: Before they go their separate ways, the KiraPâti girls face one last threat, with a little help from a mysterious stranger.

info.title: Revisions (ITA)
info.synopsis: Daisuke Dojima, 17 anni, al secondo anno dell’accademia Seisho, è sopravvissuto ad un rapimento da bambino, durante il quale era stato salvato da una misteriosa donna di nome Milo. Milo gli aveva rivelato la seguente profezia: “un giorno incorrerai in grave pericolo, quando ciò accadrà, tu sarai l’unico a poter proteggere tutti quanti”. Daisuke ha creduto ciecamente alle parole della sua salvatrice, così ha vissuto ossessivamente la sua vita in attesa di quel momento. Nessuno dei suoi amici gli ha creduto e nel tempo molti lo hanno allontanato, credendolo pazzo. Un giorno la profezia si compie: accade il misterioso fenomeno conosciuto come “Shibuya Drift”, l'intera area centrale del quartiere si solleva in aria e viene trasportata di 300 anni in un futuro post-apocalittico dove verranno subito attaccati da degli esseri denominati 'revisions', che controllano enormi ed ostili mostri meccanici. Ora i ragazzi dovranno combattere il “futuro” per far tornare il “presente”… devono tornare a casa ad ogni costo.

episodes.title: Shibuya Transfer
episodes.synopsis: Seven years after a mysterious woman named Milo saved him and his friends, Daisuke's still training and waiting for disaster to strike. Finally it does.

episodes.title: Heroic Desire
episodes.synopsis: She doesn't know him, but Milo conscripts Daisuke to fight the revision attacking the school. Shibuya officials try to figure out the situation.

episodes.title: Guardians
episodes.synopsis: It's the year 2388 and the world has fallen to a pandemic. Milo tells Daisuke and his friends what she knows about the past. Later, they find trouble.

episodes.title: First Return Plan
episodes.synopsis: Muta declares that the revisions will send a list of people back to 2017 in return for the String Puppets. An unhappy Daisuke meets a revision.

episodes.title: Appearance of the Future
episodes.synopsis: With Muta in jail and the police in charge, the S.D.S. continues to train. Daisuke thinks he's the leader, but Kuroiwa wants Gai to take on that role.

episodes.title: Because They`re Humans...
episodes.synopsis: Marimari confronts Milo in the ruins of the birthday party, demanding to know the truth about the revisions. Daisuke's uncle escapes custody.

episodes.title: Midnight Rhapsody
episodes.synopsis: With Daisuke in a holding cell, Kuroiwa and the others find out more about the revisions and what AHRV knows. Milo swears that they can return home.

episodes.title: Operation Nephilim
episodes.synopsis: Daisuke and the squad set out on a mission to rescue the hostages and destroy the artificial quantum brain -- but the revisions are ready for them.

episodes.title: Loss of Destiny

info.title: The Master of Diabolism Q
info.synopsis: Dopo aver raggiunto una terribile nomea in quanto Gran Maestro fondatore della Scuola Demoniaca, seminando terrore e morte, Wei Wuxian è finalmente sconfitto da un’alleanza di potenti Clan guidati dal suo Shidi. Si risveglia, però, tredici anni dopo, nel corpo di un giovane pazzo ed ha così una nuova occasione per essere ancora una volta vittima ed eroe del pericoloso ed affascinante mondo dei Cultori. Dovrà evitare di essere riconosciuto ma non sarà facile; uno dei primissimi incontri è proprio una vecchia conoscenza : Lan WangJi, un brillante Cultore con il quale ha un complicato rapporto di attrazione, incomprensione… e odio. I due si ritrovano di nuovo insieme, spinti ad allearsi contro un misterioso, subdolo nemico. Wei WuXian ora ha una nuova vita per risalire il baratro in cui era caduto e riunirsi ai suoi cari… e un vecchio compagno di avventure che scoprirà più vicino al suo cuore di quanto si aspettasse.

info.title: Super Pig (ITA)
info.synopsis: Karin Kokubu (Kassie Carlen nell'adattamento italiano) è una bambina che fa amicizia con un maialino giallo dotato di poteri magici come la capacità di volare e parlare. Il piccolo animaletto si rivela essere nientemeno che Tonrariano III, principe del lontano pianeta a forma di mela Buringo (Oinko nell'adattamento italiano) e dona a Karin uno speciale cofanetto rosa che consente alla bambina di trasformarsi in Tonde Burin (Super Pig nell'adattamento italiano), un maiale rose dotato di superpoteri.

episodes.title: The Birth of Super-girl Burin!
episodes.synopsis: Karin Kokubu rescues a yellow piglet on her way to school. The piglet turns out to be the prince of an alien planet, though, and turns her into the super-pig Buurin- but she'd rather be any other kind of hero.

episodes.title: The Shooting of Love and Youth
episodes.synopsis: Karin's school is having an important soccer match with a rival school, one known for their unfair tricks. Koichi, the star player of her school's team, is going to be the victim of these tricks unless Buurin does something about it.

episodes.title: Smashing Tears and Friendship
episodes.synopsis: Karin and her best friend Masami have a falling-out during tennis practice. Having a hard time making up, Karin decides to use Buurin to repair their relationship.

episodes.title: Gambling Youth on the Ring
episodes.synopsis: A local park is hosting a female pro-wrestling tournament. Among the wrestlers is an amateur, Buutan, who dresses up like Buurin to fight.

episodes.title: The Tied Friendship with Tug-A-War
episodes.synopsis: Karin's school's athletic meet is hosting a very special event: a tug-of-war match where all of the first-year students compete with Buurin. Koichi is having trouble organizing the event, though.

episodes.title: A Buurin Clay-figure Discovered!
episodes.synopsis: On a history field trip, Karin finds an ancient clay figure that looks a lot like Buurin. It leads her to some ruins that give some insight into Buurin's history.

episodes.title: The Injured Heroine
episodes.synopsis: A real bank robber interrupts a live show starring Cutey Chao, Karin's favorite heroine. Buurin must stop him quickly.

episodes.title: The Grand Diet Plan!
episodes.synopsis: Karin has been eating a lot lately, but after a comment from Koichi she decides to go on a diet. She goes too far, though, and gets weaker and weaker- this soon starts affecting Buurin's performance as well.

episodes.title: Car Warriors
episodes.synopsis: The race circuit that Keiko Kuroha's family owns is hosting a solar car race. Karin and some of her friends enter a Buurin-shaped car in the race, driven by Ms. Tateshi. When the weather takes a turn for the worse, the situation becomes tense.

episodes.title: The Fire of a Journalist`s Soul
episodes.synopsis: Shinichiro Kokobu, editor-in-chief of the Akebono Times (and Karin's father), is on the hunt for a big scoop. He has a new target that he's doing some investigative journalism on- Buurin!

episodes.title: Who Will be the Best Couple?
episodes.synopsis: The school's cultural festival includes a 'best couple' contest. Lured in by the promise of a romantic meal for the winning couple, Karin tries to win with Koichi.

episodes.title: Ultra boy KASHIWAGI Hiroumi!
episodes.synopsis: Kashiwagi has been really into the supernatural lately, and things are dialed up a notch when a series of coincidences leads him to believe that he has supernatural powers of his own.

episodes.title: Mission to swear to the Galaxy
episodes.synopsis: As Karin prepares for a big test, she finds out that Ton has a test as well. If Buurin doesn't collect 50 pearls by the deadline, Ton won't be able to become king of Buuringo.

episodes.title: Applause and cheers of theatre
episodes.synopsis: Koichi's making a movie, and he and the others have a perfect pick for the lead actress: Buurin!

episodes.title: Please protect our environment
episodes.synopsis: Kaoru, disheartened by littering citizens who won't change their ways, decides to take the task of picking up garbage into her own hands. Buurin ends up helping her.

episodes.title: The Unforgettable Christmas
episodes.synopsis: Karin is looking forward to giving Koichi a gift at a Christmas party. He says he can't come, though. Karin is suspicious- he says the reason is that he has a date with Buurin!

episodes.title: The Girl Loves Fortune-Telling
episodes.synopsis: Karin comes across an opportunity to see if her future is with Koichi.

episodes.title: New year's homesick story
episodes.synopsis: There's a big New Years' party at Karin's place! All seems well, but Ton is shut in Karin's room, missing his home planet.

episodes.title: Love danced in silvery white storm
episodes.synopsis: Karin and Koichi get to go (with the rest of their class) to a ski camp. Mr. Arashiyama seems nervous and soon enough Karin finds out he wants to profess his love to Ms. Tateshi.

episodes.title: Giant plant Keiko appeared!!
episodes.synopsis: There's a cool plant in the school (and it's named after Keiko). Trouble arises when the plant grows out of control and Buurin must defeat it.

episodes.title: Love and anguish of carouse
episodes.synopsis: Karin faces complicated feelings towards Koichi and wonders who he likes.

episodes.title: Ton-Chan's short story of love
episodes.synopsis: Ton is in love, and not with someone back on his home planet, either.

episodes.title: Duty and Challenge on February 14
episodes.synopsis: It's valentines' day, and. Buurin is helping a local sweets shop to deliver chocolates around town. As orders pile up, she worries she won't even have time to give chocolate to Koichi before the day is over.

episodes.title: Love beyond the sacred cross
episodes.synopsis: Karin's father waits for a natural phenomenon to occur.

episodes.title: Karin grants mother's wish
episodes.synopsis: Karin has to choose a doll for Girl's day. She's conflicted about which to choose, though.

episodes.title: Only one opponent
episodes.synopsis: Buurin and tennis intersect.

episodes.title: Shock! Buurin is shrunken!?
episodes.synopsis: Buurin needs to recharge, but has to rescue a puppy and stays transformed for a bit too long, then faces the consequences.

episodes.title: Young love Rhapsody
episodes.synopsis: Karin's younger brother has a girlfriend, Hitomi. All is fine until Karin finds out Hitomi has a familiar older brother, one who stood against Koichi's soccer team a while back...

episodes.title: Taken course to the island of eternal summer
episodes.synopsis: Keiko funds a class trip to Hawaii.

episodes.title: Amy disappeared into the jungle
episodes.synopsis: A rumor concerning Buurin is spreading in Hawaii.

episodes.title: Student Council's Election
episodes.synopsis: Nobody seems to want to run for student council president this year... until Keiko Kuroha steps up to the challenge and throws the entire school into election spirit.

episodes.title: The love story of late blooming cherry tree
episodes.synopsis: Jimmy Matsumoto has a turbulent history with the annual cherry trees.

episodes.title: The Common Cold
episodes.synopsis: The cold is going through town again, and this time Karin (and by extension, Buurin) gets it. It begins to interfere with Buurin's superheroine activities.

episodes.title: Friendship is represented through carp streamer
episodes.synopsis: Koichi's soccer team faces a big game, but there's some conflict between the players. Mr. Arashiyama says that carp streamers could bring them back together, though.

episodes.title: Takuma's secret identity
episodes.synopsis: Two ninjas working for Takuma's family kidnap Karin and take her to Kyoto, where her friends shortly follow. Takuma believes that Karin is in love with him.

episodes.title: Legend of the goddess dancing in the countryside
episodes.synopsis: Karin gets to help out with rice planting, but it seems tough.

episodes.title: Kouchi develops a crush on Buurin
episodes.synopsis: Koichi has written a love letter to Buurin. Karin, determined to make Koichi fall in love with her as herself instead, tries to prevent Buurin and Koichi from ever meeting again.

episodes.title: Opening a forbidden entrance
episodes.synopsis: Jimmy sees Buuringo in the sky and, while trying to investigate, falls into another dimension, creating a series of strange circumstances.

episodes.title: Mystery of the hidden family crest
episodes.synopsis: Everywhere Buurin appears, one strange mark can be found. Karin and Ton head to Kyoto in order to investigate the connection between the mark and the Mushanokoji family.

episodes.title: A girl who missed becoming the protagonist
episodes.synopsis: Kashiwagi's grandmother had the chance to become Buurin as well a long time ago.

episodes.title: Tenacious Man Jimmy Matsumoto!
episodes.synopsis: Jimmy's investigations reach their end and he has a theory: Karin and Buurin are the same person! Karin must convince him that he's wrong, somehow.

episodes.title: Buurin vs Buurin
episodes.synopsis: Just as Jimmy is about to confirm his theory, another Buurin appears! This new Buurin is fast, strong, and smart- no one seems to know who she is, and to prove herself as the one real Buurin, the original and the impostor have a showdown.

episodes.title: Ghost stories · Midsummer-night's mistake
episodes.synopsis: Karin and friends spend a night in the gym basement. Mr. Arashiyama and Karin both have something to hide, so they fake supernatural happenings.

episodes.title: The Lost Dream Tonpact
episodes.synopsis: Keiko Kuroha has found a strange compact. As it turns out, it's the very same compact that Karin uses to transform into Buurin!

episodes.title: Flashback's promise
episodes.synopsis: Karin finally gets the chance to (temporarily) transform into Cutey Chao! In a strange twist of fate, though, Buurin is needed, and so she has to transform back.

episodes.title: Goodbye creeping footsteps
episodes.synopsis: Ton and Karin might have to break up their friendship as Karin moves in on her goal of 108 pearls.

episodes.title: Creepy Discovery at Keiko's pavilion
episodes.synopsis: Keiko is having a dinner party at her massive, luxurious mansion. It turns out, though, that her parents only come home once a year.

episodes.title: When the flower garden of evil laughs
episodes.synopsis: An entrance in a basement leads to another world.

episodes.title: Crisis!!! Sei Ringo Academy is attacked
episodes.synopsis: Monsters from Keiko's mansion have broken into the outside world, and they're attacking the school. Karin can't find time to transform into Buurin and fears she'll have to do it in front of the others, locking her into Buurin form forever.

episodes.title: The Inability to transform back into Karin
episodes.synopsis: Karin decides to reveal she's Buurin and transform to save the city, but doing this will mean she can never transform back into Karin.

episodes.title: Karin's and Buurin's Future
episodes.synopsis: Apparently there need to be 7 Buurins to use the 7 talismans... but there's just one. Karin needs the strength of all of her friends to save the world.

info.title: Kuromukuro (ITA)
info.synopsis: 2016 – Gole di Tateyama, Kurobe, grazie alle ricerche condotte su di un misterioso artefatto, il Kuromukuro, scoperto accidentalmente durante gli scavi di costruzione della diga, l’ingegneria robotica ha fatto enormi progressi… Intanto Kennosuke Tokisada Oma, un antico samurai, si risveglia ai giorni nostri ed incontra Yukina Shirahane, la figlia del capo-laboratorio delle Nazioni Unite.

variants.title: Kuromukuro
Kuromukuro

episodes.title: A Demon Falls from the Sky
episodes.synopsis: Yuhina Shirahane visits het mother at the United Nations Kurobe Research Institute. Here she learns of the "giant"  and the "cube" unknown objects that enabled the institute and her mother to develop new technology. Suddenly fast incoming objects from the sky appear and one is headed straight for the institute.

episodes.title: The Black Shell Awakens
episodes.synopsis: Multiple locations are under attack from unknown attackers. At the United Nations Kurobe Research Institute they deploy their latest mech suits into the battle. On the inside Yukina triggers the "cube" and a lonely samurai appears who protects his "princess" Yukina from the attackers. Before Yukina and the institute can figure out who the samurai warrior is, he deploys the cube and activates " the giant"  which is a powerful mobile suit warrior. The giant, with the samurai in control and Yukina as an accidental co-pilot, moves forward across Japan to seek and destroy the demons.

episodes.title: The Silent Walls of a Castle
episodes.synopsis: After his battle with one of the demons, the samurai Kennosuke is captured and taken into custody. Kennosuke seems to originate from the Sengoku period about 450 years ago. He escapes from his jail, but doing so he unwillingly endangers Koharu, Yukina's little sister. Kennosuke manages to summon the cube, his transport vessel and rescues Koharu from a smaller demon. The Monk Osho Yakushi convinces Kennosuke to battle the unknown demons from the skies at their side.

episodes.title: A Strange, New World
episodes.synopsis: Kennosuke is adjusting to the 21st century which also includes a trip to the shopping mall together with Yukina. The demons past is hidden in history and only Yukina's father did research, until he mysteriously disappeared. From these studies they hope to discover more about the demons and how their connection to Kennosuke, the only survivor of the Wasabi clan.

episodes.title: The Samurai Goes to School
episodes.synopsis: Kennosuke's introduction into the modern world continues. His fellow mobile armor pilots decide his callsign is " Ken". Both Yukina and Kennosuke are apperently linked with implants to the steed and the giant, to some dismay of at least one of the other mobile suit pilots. Just when "Ken" is settling into Yukon's class and school a call to arms is given.

episodes.title: Face-Off at Jinzu River
episodes.synopsis: The Artifact, Gaus 1 and Gaus 2 mobile suits engage into battle with the "Yellow Crab" geoframe and two of his red minions. While suffering serious damage to the Artifact, Kennosuke manages to defeat the Yellow Crab. An apparently human pilot appears from the geoframes cockpit, who identifies himself as Hedo from the Frontier Reform Office. After asking Kennosuke why he betrays his own kind, the pilot activates the self-destruct sequence of his disabled geoframe.

episodes.title: Vanishing into the Dawn
episodes.synopsis: Yukina is in doubt if she wants to continue to co-pilot the artifact. Meanwhile two of her fellow students who went "thrill seeking" at the last battle are still missing. After an incident with her mother Kennosuke notices Yukina has disappeared from her home.

episodes.title: Memories of Regret
episodes.synopsis: While everyone is looking for the missing Yukina she decides to launch her own investigation into her fathers notebook, starting at the remains of the ruins of Kennosuke's clan. There she is attacked and rescued by a mysterious demon. The demons in orbit demand the artifact returned to them, however the artifact is the only "ace" the earths has against them. As a direct response another Geoframe attack is launched on Japan. With Yukina missing and Kennosuke in pursuit to find her there is no one to pilot the artifact.....

episodes.title: The Ogre`s Message
episodes.synopsis: With Yukina back in the co-pilot seat the Black Relic is back in action. They launch at incoming geoframes which try to beam themselves and the Black Relic up to their mothership. This plan gets disrupted and with the help of Gaus 1 and 2 the Geoframes are disabled. But in a surprise turn of the situation the pilot of the main geoframe surrenders.

episodes.title: The Arrogant Captive
episodes.synopsis: The captured demon pilot, named Fusnarnie, and Kennosuke are both questioned about their origins. Kennosuke tells the tale of him and the Princess fighting their last battle together in the Black Relic. However Kennosuke can't seem too recall or admit if he knows Fusnarnie from the past. Meanwhile Fusnarnie disables his guards and remotely activates the longarm "callsign Lion" Geoframe to come and get him. But on his way out he stumbles upon Yukina whom he recognizes as a wielder.....

episodes.title: Truth Shrouded in Darkness
episodes.synopsis: The enemy pilot unexpectedly escapes and is able to restore his geoframe. Yukina is ordered to deploy in the Kuromukuro, but runs into him on the way.

episodes.title: Summer Hell Camp in Kurobe
episodes.synopsis: Summer vacation has come, and that means more training for Ken and Yukina, who is improving more than she expected. Akagi hopes to become a pilot.

episodes.title: Welcome to the Festival
episodes.synopsis: Ken's Kuromukuro fights alongside the GAUS to drive off a giant geoframe. Meanwhile, Kayahara's plan for the Culture Fair stirs up excitement.

episodes.title: Rasetsu Dance Festival
episodes.synopsis: Before Muetta can kill Kennosuke, she is stopped by a tall masked figure. Kennosuke is alive but badly wounded. Muetta escapes the attack by the stranger and calls for her Medusa geoframe, which launches from the mothership. Muetta enters the geoframe and is immediately attacked by the two GAUS units, but manages to escape. Kennosuke recovers enough to pilot the Kuromukuro and confronts Muetta in her Medusa geoframe who he still believes is Princess Yukihime. Mirasa in the Spider geoframe arrives and joins the fight. The two GAUS units also arrive and engage Mirasa’s Spider geoframe. The GAUS units and Kuromukuro fight as a team and damage Mirasa’s Spider geoframe, prompting Muetta and Mirasa to retreat back to the Efy Dolgh mothership.

episodes.title: The End of Oiwake
episodes.synopsis: Kennosuke is badly injured in the fight with the geoframes and is taken into the UN facility for medical treatment. Meanwhile, many civilians are leaving Tateyama because of the geoframe attacks. Kennosuke has visions of the past including Princess Yukihime and the tall masked figure conferring about him. Again, he recovers from his near fatal wounds through a rapid self-healing process. Ogino wants the Akagi and Kaya to make a cosplay video for her. The Efy Dolgh officers debate what to do about the Black Relic, but Muetta and Mirasa seek to redeem themselves and secretly depart for Earth.

episodes.title: The Flowing Water Reunion
episodes.synopsis: Efy Dolgh fighters, Muetta and Mirasa, arrive at Kurobe Dam. Ogino and the school group travel to find a location to film her cosplay. She has asked Marina along to lift her spirits after she tendered her resignation because of the Efy Dolgh attack at the school’s cultural festival. The UN plans for Sophie’s departure for France and trial single-pilot GAUS units to increase their capacity to deal with the enemy geoframes, but with mixed success. Kennosuke and Sophie discuss the meaning of freedom. Meanwhile, Muetta and Mirasa gain entry to the UN facilty. They capture Kennosuke, who still believes that Muetta is Princess Yukihime, but she denies knowing him. They find the excavation site with the final fragments of the hinge stone. Confronted by UN troops, Kennosuke tries to defend Muetta, but Sophie says that he is foolish, and vows to stay at the facility. As they are about to leave, Mirasa stabs Muetta so that she can take sole credit for the discovery. Muetta jumps from the dam wall into the rushing waters below.

episodes.title: Oni Dancing in the Clouds
episodes.synopsis: Efy Dolgh soldier Imusa descends again to Earth to find the remaining three Hinge Stones, including the Keystone. The GAUS crew waits for new parts to arrive and debate whether or not Muetta is Princess Yukihime. Kennosuke uses the Black Relic to search for Muetta. Efy Dolgh soldier Yoruba travels to Japan in the flying Bluebird geoframe to check on his comrades and also shoots down the transport plane carrying the GAUS replacement parts. The crew manage to offload the parts before crash-landing into the dam where Kennosuke uses the Black Relicto save the plane and crew. Yoruba in the Bluebird geoframe finds Mirasa who lies about the fate of Muetta and he goes in search of her. He sees the Black Relic and attacks, but during the aerial battle the Demon attaches his own flying geoframe to the Black Relic to help Kennosuke. However, because of Kennosuke's mistrust of demons it departs, but promises assist him if needed.

episodes.title: Yukemuri Disappears
episodes.synopsis: The JSDF, UN, and Efy Dolgh search for Muetta. Yukina's class decide to go to Toyama Memorial hot springs at “Kenshin’s hidden residence” for the weekend. Not all end up going, only the core group of Yukina's friends. Meanwhile the wounded Muetta takes refuge at the hot springs, hoping to aid her recovery. After getting lost, Yukina and Kennosuke arrive at the same spring, where they stumble upon Muetta, and the UN takes her into custody. Just then, a Cactus unit appears, captures Yukina, and escapes back into orbit.

episodes.title: Invitation to a Demon`s Feast
episodes.synopsis: The Cactus unit returns to the space station with Yukina whom the Efy Dolgh believe is Muetta. At the UN, Dr. Hausen reveals that Yukina and Muetta share the same DNA and concludes that Yukina was taken by mistake. The UN discuss a rescue mission, but no decision is made. While sitting alone Sophie sees some writing appear, asking if she wants to learn the truth about demons. She agrees, and when she returns home the Demon is waiting. He introduces himself as Zeringer Mundef Bischrei. He reveals little, only that he is an enemy of the Efy Dolgh. Kennosuke asks Muetta (Yukihime) if she will pilot the Kuromukuro (Black Grongul) with him. She agrees to assist him to take the Kuromukuro to the space station, but cannot guarantee his return. As they prepare to leave in the Kuromukuro, they see a recorded message from Princess Yukihime imploring her ancestors to fight the demons and protect the Washiba Clan. Muetta wonders if there are things about her past that she does not know. On the space station, Yukina escapes from captivity and realises that she's no longer on Earth.

episodes.title: The Tiger`s Maw Leaping into the Fire
episodes.synopsis: Yukina explores the Efy Dolgh mothership and encounters Mirasa who gives chase, believing she’s Muetta. Yukina manages to access the Efy Dolgh data banks and learns about their plans. Kennosuke takes off in the Kuromukuro with Muetta, and Major Graham arrests Director Shirahane for the lapse in security. The Demon reveals to Sophie that the Efy Dolgh aim for planet domination, and that his planet was conquered by them. He says that the Efy Dolgh geoframes encountered on earth are only reconnaissance units and the invasion force is far more powerful. He leaves her a memory stick with data about them. Meanwhile Muetta requests retrieval in the Kuromukuro Glongur and the Efy Dolgh beam it up to their ship. She reports to the Efy Dolgh leaders and learns that they planted seeds of life on various planets, including Earth. When Kennosuke is detected on board, the Efy Dolgh accuse Muetta of being a traitor and attack her. Kennosuke, Muetta and Yukina meet and join forces, leaving the mothership in their Glongurs. As they fall towards Earth the Demon intercepts them and carries them down towards. The UN facility is notified by NORAD that the Efy Dolgh mothership is descending to the planet surface.

episodes.title: The Day the Stronghold Fell
episodes.synopsis: The Kuromukuro and Medusa Glongurs return to Earth assisted by the Demon but Muetta is arrested. Zeru the Demon explains that Yukihime died 450 years ago, and that Muetta is a copy based on her genetic information. He says the Efy Dolgh create clones of the lifeforms they conquer and implant false memories in them to be loyal Efy Dolgh vanguards - only by uniting can they defeat the Efy Dolgh invasion. He tells Yukina that her father Takehito was a close friend. While people are evacuating, the Efy Dolgh mothership starts launching multiple geoframes including the Spider and Rock Head piloted by Yoruba and Imusa, The Demon flies the Kuromukuro to confront them while the three single pilot GAUS units engage the headless geoframes on the ground. The battle is fierce, and the UN facility is breached. The Efy Dolgh mothership drops hundreds of cactus units which release electronic parasites that take control of the staff. Sophie gets others to help rescue Muetta while Sebastian in his GAUS unit sacrifices himself to destroy Mirasa's Spider geoframe, while the woman manages to survive instead. Kennosuke in the Kuromukuro picks up Tom Borden in the remaining GAUS unit and they depart the overrun UN Kurobe facility.

episodes.title: A Demon Crying in the Snow
episodes.synopsis: Yukina, Kennosuke and all the others who escaped the attack on the research facility retreat to the school, which has become the new UN's HQ. The entire region is completely isolated from the rest of the world because of the barrier created by Efy Dolgh. That night, the Demon speaks to Kennosuke, Yukina and her mother, revealing to them how he met Yukina's father years ago, shortly before his death from a sudden avalanche. Meanwhile, the Efy Dolgh manage to excavate the hinge stone from the dam's excavation, using the parasited humans as slaves. The stone draws in surrounding heat, cooling the area and provoking a snow storm over Kurobe. Muetta, having finally accepted the fact that she's been cloned, and all of her memories are fake, escapes from the base. While she's searching for Muetta, Yukina collapses in the snow. When Muetta finds her, she and Yukina take refuge in an old house where they're reached by Kennosuke. Muetta reveals to them that the Efy Dolgh are planning to use the hinge stone to create a wormhole between the Earth and its homeland, to enable the main army to storm the planet and subjugate it.

episodes.title: Frogs Singing in the Snow
episodes.synopsis: The student attendance to Mt. Tate high school has decreased significantly, which makes it all the more surprising when Yukina and Ken arrive accompanied by Muetta. Carlos brings up his movie idea from the time at the onsen again and announces that he completed the script.

episodes.title: The Bloody Battle of Kurobe Dam
episodes.synopsis: The UN forces trapped inside the bubble launch an all out attack on the Efidolg forces surrounding their mothership and the abandoned laboratory base in order to take back control of the facilities and rescue any potential survivors. The Black Relic and GAUS-1 piloted by Sophie face off against the countless robots of the enemy, while Muetta retrieves her own Medusa and confronts Mirasa over the true nature of the Efidolg.

episodes.title: The Dream the Demons Had
episodes.synopsis: The battle is over, the activation of the Hinge halted. The UN establishes new policies to recover from the alien attack while Kennosuke decides on a path to his future.

episodes.title: The Samurai Who Doesn`t Look Back
episodes.synopsis: With the security lockdown after the attack tightening on Zeru and Muetta, Kennosuke decides to accompany them on a last ditch effort to answer the call to defeat the Efidolg that was received through the Hinge's aborted activation.

episodes.title: The Fate As a Warrior
episodes.synopsis: A flashback episode, "Fate as a Warrior" shows Mahoro as a Vesper combat android, undergoing training and fighting her first battles. Endurance tests under various extreme environmental conditions, while too short to be truly useful, nonetheless succeed in giving her an appreciation of life, and her first battle is an overwhelming victory. The episode also shows fully the battle in which Cmdr. Misato, really the first person to accept Mahoro as more than merely a weapon, lost his life. It is the memory of his life - and his death - that really leads Mahoro to accept the full weight of her own existence, and to desperately want to continue living for as long as she can.

episodes.title: In the Garden Where the Hydrangeas Bloom
episodes.synopsis: Suguru Misato, a young teen boy living by himself since his parents have passed away a few years ago, decides to hire a maid to help clean up his house. Enter Mahoro, a former combat android created to defend the Earth against a secret alien invasion in the early 1980's. Given the choice of continuing in her service for Vesper and functioning for a mere 37 days or retiring, giving up her combat armor and continuing to function for 398 days, Mahoro has chosen to serve as a maid to one Suguru Misato.

episodes.title: Woman Teacher Saori, 25 Years Old
episodes.synopsis: Back at school, Suguru now has to explain his new lifestyle to his friends, since it's pretty difficult to hide the fantastic lunches that Mahoro packs for him and the well-pressed clothing that he now wears. His close friends, Hamaji and Kawahara are immediately infatuated with Mahoro's beauty, while Miyuki and Rin are slightly jealous of the same. And then there's Chizuko, the Food Connoisseur, who is completely taken with Mahoro's cooking expertise. To round off this cast of characters, Ms. Shikijo, their over-sexed school teacher, has an instant dislike for Mahoro and the attention she commands from young Suguru. This causes Ms. Shikijo to set her goal in seducing Suguru away from Mahoro. This, in addition to Mahoro's dislike for lewd and indecent behavior, has automatically created a competitive atmosphere between the two ladies. So watch out when the battle begins!

episodes.title: A Grave So Transient
episodes.synopsis: After Suguru's water heater breaks, Ms. Shikijo and Mahoro's rivalry explodes during a visit to a Bath House where Miyuki's family works. July 19th, and school has ended. July 20th marks the day that Suguru's father has passed away. In memory of his passing, Suguru asks Mahoro to accompany him to the gravesite, not knowing that Mr. Misato had once worked for Vesper and served as Mahoro's superior in this secret organization. Not only does Suguru feel the loss of his father, but Mahoro, equally, if not more so is torn at the loss of Suguru's father for reasons that only she knows.

episodes.title: Shoot Me Straight Through the Heart
episodes.synopsis: It's summertime and a everyone travels to the beach for some fun in the sun! However, things go awry when an alien anti-android robot appears and strips off all the female bathing suits *ahem*. Mahoro must now return briefly to her combat mode to take care of this threat. Will she be able to take care of this now that she has discarded her combat armor?

episodes.title: 8-634 Is Doing Fine
episodes.synopsis: During a VESPER staff review of Mahoro's life and activities following her entry into civilian life, a letter from Mahoro is read to the assembled officers. In it, she describes taking part in a "summer vacation group research trip" to explore the notorious "nine mysteries" of Hiryu School 4. Seven of these are generally acknowledged to be no more than standard rumors typical of any school; the remaining two, however, have not been as easy to put to rest. Of course what Suguru, Kiyomi and Toshiya don't know is that all through, the three girls, minus Mahoro, are playing them, as part and parcel of their own "human response to stress" research project. But seek, and ye shall find: it does not take much to send them running frantically through the school to get away from "red-haired Ando", according to legend, a girl who fell to her death from the school roof years ago and has been haunting the halls at night ever since. Mahoro herself is in on the joke, though she plays along. The twist, however, comes when, after becoming separated from the group, she comes across the real Ando, a ghost or spirit trapped in the school until she can confess her love to a boy whose own spirit is trapped in another part of the building. Reunited by Mahoro, the two ghosts, now freed - and together - disappear, and the letter concludes.

episodes.title: Moon Flower Design
episodes.synopsis: As the number of contacts between SAINT and humans increases, VESPER officers agree that alone and stripped of most of her combat capabilities, Mahoro is in danger. To counteract this threat, her combat support mech unit, V1046-R9 Slash Zero, is authorized to join her in the human world. In the meanwhile, the Hiryu town Summer Festival is fast approaching. Each year, the leading citizens of the town select one girl to be featured in the hours-long Dance of the Dead, a grueling performance that pushes one to the limits of her abilities and endurance. This year, Mahoro is the one chosen. In the few days remaining before the Festival, then, she is occupied almost entirely with pracicing the dance. The question of what to wear for the event, which calls for traditional clothing, is answered when Suguru pulls his his mother's yukata and Cmdr. Misato's kimono out of storage. After extensive practice, Mahoro performs magnificently, dancing nonstop for three hours and eleven minutes. According to one of the residents, hers is the best dance in at least a decade. Following the conclusion of it, her and Saori, herself chosen to perform several years earlier, engage in some not-so-friendly "competition" at the various festival booths, with Suguru as the prize - which leads, in short order, to both of them being banned. As the festival comes to a close with a fireworks display, Suguru remarks that this is the first time since the death of his parents that he has been able to actually enjoy himself. In due time, as him and Mahoro rejoin the rest of Suguru's classmates to watch the fireworks, he asks Mahoro to come to the festival next year, as well. Knowing what he still does not, though, she pauses. Her answer, "it'd be nice to come again," - nothing more, and nothing less.

episodes.title: The Maid Chased by Her Past
episodes.synopsis: The summer vacation comes to an end, and Suguru, Miyuki, Rin and the others return to school. On the very first day, as they are walking to class, Chizuko is nearly run down by an out-of-control car, but saved by a mysterious man who appears, seemingly out of nowhere, and leaves as quicky. Later in the day, the same man, Tou Ryuga, reappears again, as a substitute teacher hired by the school. But later still, at the mention of his name, Mahoro grows uneasy. The reason, revealed in the evening of the same day, is simple: much like Mahoro herself, Ryuga is a combat android, only in the service of the alien invaders SAINT. He attacks Mahoro as she is out shopping, and although Mahoro and Slash gain the upper hand, she feels that rather than being able to defeat Ryuga, she is merely being allowed to survive. Before he leaves, however, Ryuga declares his intention - to challenge Mahoro and make the final determination of which one of them is the better warrior. During Mahoro's active service, her and Ryuga engaged - inconclusively - several times. Now, though, the first step he takes is finding out just what the nature of the relationship between Mahoro and Suguru, whom he knows to the the son of Commander Ryoh Misato, is. It is to this effect that he infiltrates Suguru's school and interrogates his various friends. The responses are nothing but praise - and in the cases of Miyuki and Rin, blushing and mumbling - although unsurprisingly, Saori misinterprets the situation and perceives Ryoh as a rival for Suguru's affections. Later, Slash and Mahoro, who also infiltrate the school, challenge him. Mahoro threatens to fight Ryuga right there and then, if that would mean protecting Suguru. Whether he is truly concerned or simply looking for an excuse to put the battle off is not clear, but he declares that he is unwilling to fight in a location where civilians could be harmed, and leaves.

episodes.title: One Who Has a Perfect Heart
episodes.synopsis: As SAINT combat android Tou Ryuga enters the lives of Suguru and his friends, disguised as a substitute teacher, Suguru becomes aware that some sort of connection exists between Ryuga and Mahoro. To further understand their relationship, Suguru invites all of his friends, as well as both Ryuga and Saori to a party at his house. At the same time, Mahoro is becoming more and more aware that her view of herself - as well as her relationship to Suguru - is changing the more she time she spends living with him. Originally, she saw herself as merely atoning for causing Commander Misato's death, but as the days go by, she comes to realize that what she is truly looking for is a place to belong, a home to be able to take care of and come back to, and people to care for. In contrast, Ryuga's self-examination shows that he sees his entire raison d'etre as fighting - and defeating - Mahoro. His entire identity is of a warrior who was defeated once but is desperate for a second chance, because without it, he is nothing. The party at Suguru's house, where Ryuga comes to realize that Suguru, despite suspecting the depth of Mahoro's past is still unaware of his role in it, sets the stage for the final confrontation between the two combat androids. However, Suguru's intervention means that the actual duel will take place two days later, in a mutually agreed-upon location. With the time and place of the duel now determined, Mahoro again faces the fact that Suguru still has no knowledge of her impending death. She has already caused him immeasurable pain once, and is left to wonder - it is worth living just a few more months with him if the end will still be same pain.

episodes.title: Limelight
episodes.synopsis: With the time and place of the final duel with Tou Ryuga now set, Mahoro really has nothing left to lose, and uses the opportunity to ask Suguru out on a "date" to Yokohama. The effect is predictable: both him and Saori are prompted to imagine all the romantic implications of such a situation, and of course, when Mahoro and Suguru finally depart, Saori is right there, pursuing them on her Vespa. It's an uneven match, but the woman certainly gets points for persistence... The "date" itself is absolutely idyllic, as per Mahoro's expectation of "fun, tea, fun, lunch...and then more fun!" - an amusement park trip, shopping, lunch, then the warm early fall evening at a park. And when she reveals Ryuga's true identity to Suguru, he is not particularly surprised. Later on still, as Sugur and Mahoro are gazing over the nighttime city, she tells him that since beginning to work at the house, she has been able to find happiness. But when in Suguru's reply, it is clear that he knows there is much more about her - and about her relationship to him - that she is not telling, Mahoro can't help but face the full weight of reality: her past, her loneliness, and the fact that she is very much living on borrowed time. Suguru then plays his hand and asks Mahoro to explain her past as a combat android when she feels she is able to do so. After they return home, Suguru, tired, goes off to bed, though despite being exhausted, he is unable to fall asleep and lies there, thinking. As soon as he heads out, though, Mahoro changes into her battle outfit and sets out for the duel with Ryuga, determined, however, to defeat him - and to come back alive...

Endurance tests under various extreme environmental conditions, while too short to be truly useful, nonetheless succeed in giving her an appreciation of life, and her first battle is an overwhelming victory. The episode also shows fully the battle in which Cmdr. Misato, really the first person to accept Mahoro as more than merely a weapon, lost his life. It is the memory of his life - and his death - that really leads Mahoro to accept the full weight of her own existence, and to desperately want to continue living for as long as she can.

episodes.title: A Person Precious to Me
episodes.synopsis: As Mahoro and Ryuga face off in the final battle they both planned for, each has a person waiting for them: Suguru back at the Misato house and Sara in the SAINT spaceship in Earth orbit. Looking at the planet, Sara can't help but think about the irony of the way SAINT's ages-long quest for contact with another civilization has turned out, with mankind's response being the "most primitive" - war. For her own part, Mahoro again makes it clear that, although her original reason for deciding to live in the human world was to serve penance, in the months since, she has come to genuinely enjoy her existence within the ties of friendship that go along with being human. To the end, though, she also understands that there can be no other resolution to the opposition between her and Ryuga, and so, the battle is on. With her strength and capacity severely diminished after she was decomissioned, Mahoro is able to hold Ryuga off, but it is very obvious that the battle is not being fought on equal terms. As she exhausts her ammunition, without inflicting any noticeable damage, it is clear that if she is to survive, Mahoro must resort to far more drastic means. It is at this time, too, that Suguru, waking from a short nap in his room, comes downstairs and discovers a set dinner...and Mahoro's farewell letter. Within seconds, his mind is set; he needs to be wherever she is, regardless of what happens. Slash resists briefly, but cannot do so any further after Suguru explicitly invokes his status as Mahoro's - and by extension, his - "master," and issues a direct order to be taken to the location of the duel. Even though weakened, Mahoro still has a few tricks up her sleeve. A personal shielding system offers some protection, at least against projectiles, while several explosive charges, uniquely shaped like throwing knives to deceive an opponent destroy the building and force the fight outside, where Mahoro can draw on the power of one of her last remaining weapons. episodes.title: To the Scenery I Once Dreamt Of
episodes.synopsis: Mahoro may be the Earth's greatest weapon, but human technology is still only so much; whatever the reasons and explanations, Ryuga does take a direct hit from an antimatter cannon...and shrugs it off. Mahoro is caught off guard, and her last thoughts before she blacks out are that if she somehow gets out of this alive, she still just might get back home before Sugur wakes up, destroy the note she left, and go on as if nothing at all happened. So black out she does, into her personal True Happiness that is a morning, any morning, cooking and ready to face the day. Of course it only gets better from there; Suguru suggests a picnic, and soon enough, the whole gang, Miyuki and Rin and Chizuko, Kiyomi and Toshiya, are at the door, yelling to Mahoro to come and join them...So just like on so many other sundays, a hillside picnic, a perfect day, friends, food, Shikijo-sensei the annoying, ridiculous...but familiar. Then, as the four girls are perched in a majestic tree looking over as much of the world as matters for them, the talk turns to dreams and aspirations. Sakura, Rin and Chizuko's answers are completely predictable, but as they turn to Mahoro with the same question - what it is that she dreams of - cue the end of the dream... And cue nothing but pain, as Mahoro snaps back into reality. But though she may be weakend and injured, on the brink of realizing that she may not be coming home after all, her and Ryuga both know she is still not at her limit. What Ryuga can't quite figure out, though, is why? And when he is about to unleash his own ultimate weapon - Ray Blade - all Mahoro does is stand there and wait for death to take her...because in the end, one death is the same as another. It is just at this moment, not a second too soon, really, that Suguru comes dashing into the middle of the fight. Like he said, he is all too aware he is not able to actually affect what happens in any real way...but that isn't the point; he does all he can - protects the one he care

info.title: Shingu: Secret of the Stellar Wars
info.synopsis: È il 2070. Hajime, rappresentante di classe al secondo anno presso la scuola media Misumaru, conduce una vita tranquilla e ordinaria nella città di Tenmo. Ma un giorno, due eventi stravolgono la sua visione del mondo circostante: l'apparizione di un gigantesco mecha bianco che fronteggia un'apparente invasione aliena, e l'arrivo di Muryou Subaru, uno studente trasferito con una predilezione per le divise scolastiche dei tempi andati, e una straordinaria abilità nel combattimento e nell'uso della telecinesi. Come Hajime presto scoprirà, Muryou non è l'unico alla Misumaru con poteri e responsabilità speciali. Come sarà connesso tutto ciò alla Federazione Galattica aliena e allo strano gigante bianco chiamato Shingu?

episodes.title: The War Record Begins
episodes.synopsis: Aliens in the Tokyo Bay District? A new transfer student who acts suspiciously? Hajime Murata is in store for a lot more than he can handle.

episodes.title: Muryou`s Power
episodes.synopsis: Hajime witnesses an argument gone battle that involves more than just fists between Muryou and Kyoichi. Bewildered by this show of psychic powers, Hajime questions Muryou. What will he tell Hajime?

episodes.title: The Name Is Shingu
episodes.synopsis: The talk around Misumaru Middle School is that someone stole a pair of girls clothing from the school. Who is this thief and what connections does he have with the strange events witnessed by Hajime?

episodes.title: The Time to Move
episodes.synopsis: Hajime attempts to uncover the secrets of Tenmo town while those behind the strange events watch him.

episodes.title: Gazing Eyes
episodes.synopsis: Hajime has learned the origin of Shingu and everything that has gone on in Tenmo, yet life still continues to remain normal for him. Elsewhere, Jiltosh attempts to tutor an alien spy, but with terrible results.

episodes.title: A Peaceful Battle
episodes.synopsis: It's the arrival of the Athletic Festival and both teams, the Red team and the White team, are both eager to win. On the Red team we've got Kyoich who wants to blaze a path to victory, while on the White team we've got Nayuta who's equally revved up. Will Muryou and Hajime be able to help her do just that? At the same time, someone has snuck onto school grounds.

episodes.title: Your Smile
episodes.synopsis: While the Athletic Festival may be over, people are still wondering who the victor of the final event was. At the same time, everyone has a chance to watch the Cheer team skits, much to the shock of Nayuta and Kyoichi who both participated.

episodes.title: A Humble Feast
episodes.synopsis:
Hachiyou comes up with an idea for the pending Cultural Festival, but it would seem that Nayuta won't here of it. Even with the support of Hajime and Muryou, Nayuta still refuses to allow it.

After a fire destroys Jiltosh's house, he and Weinul, the Zaiglian who had previously requested asylum on Earth, move into the Sanemori manor. A run in with Hajime's mother while grocery shopping causes Hajime's family to have dinner with them.

episodes.title: After the Rain, More Rain
episodes.synopsis: Before, the Zaiglians were always content to lurk around in shadows… but no longer. Jiltosh and the others now find themselves face-to-face with the largest squadron of Zaiglian soldiers ever to set foot in Tenmo.

episodes.title: For Tomorrow
episodes.synopsis: Something big is coming. School has been cancelled, and the Student Government has been called into a secret meeting with the Sanemori Clan. Most of the students happily head home, oblivious to the danger; but Hajime is about to be witness to one of the Shingu’s most powerful secrets…

episodes.title: Thank You, Courage
episodes.synopsis: The battle with the “Sanadon” is at hand! Using the dangerous technique of Astral Deviation, Nayuta’s spirit is sent into space along with the Shingu to fight. But with an invasion force closing in on the Chosen’s location on the ground, it’s up to Harumi to protect everyone.

episodes.title: Despite Friendship
episodes.synopsis: Nayuta’s been acting a little strange lately. Normally very confrontational, she seems to be backing off… what could be bothering her so much that her personality has changed 180 degrees?

episodes.title: Secret Village Hometown
episodes.synopsis: Exams are over and the summer is finally here. That means it’s time for a little summer trip! Setsuna invites Hajime, Shun, and Nayuta to visit the mysterious Village of Falling Stars… but this little vacation isn’t going to be all fun and games…

episodes.title: Our Summer
episodes.synopsis: The evidence from the battle with Sanadon leads to some troubling discoveries for the Sanemori Clan. Of course, laid-back Jiltosh would rather everyone focus on a more important matter… the Zaiglians are finally returning home and that means a going-away party is in order!

episodes.title: Father`s Return
episodes.synopsis: Hajime’s father, Kazuo Murata, is finally getting a vacation to see his family! What is it, exactly, that he does again? But his appearance at home is overshadowed by a startling announcement on the early morning news…

episodes.title: Calmly, but Suddenly
episodes.synopsis: Alien forces are on the move and, aside from keeping Setsuna up all night, they seem to have a darker purpose. With a new impending invasion, could it be time to ask for the Galactic Federation’s support?

episodes.title: Chaotic Apology
episodes.synopsis: Everyone is shocked to discover that Hajime’s father is involved with the space diplomacy talks - even Hajime! But right now Hajime is more focused on the Festival Club. Nayuta seems to be taking a special interest in the club and she decides to hold a meeting regarding their plans for the Cultural Festival, but the meeting is cut short when yet another alien battleship appears!

episodes.title: Inherited Sorrows
episodes.synopsis: The students stumble upon an old video containing a short film from 100 years ago! Who could that be playing the lead? Is it… a young Lady Momoe? While the Festival Club draws in the curious viewers, a troubled Harumi must face Kyoichi and tell him the truth… the truth about what really happened 11 years ago.

episodes.title: Virtuous Fist
episodes.synopsis: Aliens have appeared in Kyushu and they’re making short work of the Protectors! Will Harumi be strong enough to protect the Chosen by herself? And why isn’t Muryou around when he’s needed the most?

episodes.title: Impatient Optimism
episodes.synopsis: It’s festival time at Futaba’s elementary school! The members of the Festival Club have been invited to participate and that means a fun change of pace for the weary middle school students.

episodes.title: Helpers Meet
episodes.synopsis: The sports clubs have finally cornered Muryou! Will he finally agree to help them in their upcoming judo match against Misumaru’s school rival, Miyanomori? One match couldn’t really hurt, right?

episodes.title: Gazing Beyond
episodes.synopsis: There’s a mysterious new student wandering around in Tenmo. All that’s known about this pale-skinned, green-eyed newcomer is his name: Kanata. But while Momoe and the others try to dig up information on him, he’s busy tracking down Muryou! Is he a friend or a foe?

episodes.title: Federation and Alliance
episodes.synopsis: It’s a day like any other in Tenmo… except that a gigantic spaceship is now hovering low in the skies over the town. While most people are in a frenzied panic, the natives of Tenmo are strangely calm - until a second spaceship closes in and the two ships face-off!

episodes.title: Destined Ones Gather
episodes.synopsis: With the looming alien threat, school has been cancelled… but that hasn’t stopped the students of Misumaru Middle School from making their own plans for the day! Danger surrounds them, but it will be a day of revelation both for the people of Tenmo, and the world.

episodes.title: An Empty Soul Awakens
episodes.synopsis: Nayuta is forced to take drastic action. As she pushes the power of the Shingu farther than ever before, the Shingu’s darkest secret will finally be revealed.

episodes.title: School Record Continue
episodes.synopsis: …you didn’t really think we’d tell you how it ends, did you?

info.title: Gordian Warrior (ITA)
info.synopsis: La storia è ambientata nel futuro, Daigo, adolescente spericolato, arriva -in compagnia della sua pantera robot- nella città di Victor Town, giusto in tempo per trovarla sotto attacco da parte di un esercito di fanatici equipaggiati con armi sofisticate. I due vengono vengono arruolati in una forza di difesa, ma le cose sembrano mettersi molto male. Ma, all'improvviso, fa la sua comparsa un gigantesco guerriero robot, Gordian.

info.title: The World Is Dancing
info.synopsis: Nel Giappone del XIV secolo, un periodo segnato da guerre civili e profondi cambiamenti sociali, Oniyasha cresce all’interno di una compagnia itinerante di sarugaku, l'arte popolare che sarebbe poi diventata il Teatro Nō. Tra danze, recitazioni e spettacoli nei villaggi, il giovane osserva la vita degli altri senza riuscire a comprenderne appieno il senso: perché le persone danzano? Perché mostrano gioia e dolore attraverso il corpo? La sua curiosità prende forma quando assiste a una performance che scuote profondamente il suo spirito. Da quel momento, ogni incontro e ogni gesto diventano per lui un’occasione di scoperta: Oniyasha si mette alla ricerca del significato dell’arte, imparando a trasformare ogni passo e ogni espressione in un racconto capace di comunicare emozioni, segnando così il cammino che lo porterà a essere parte della storia del teatro giapponese.

episodes.title: Why Do People Dance?
episodes.synopsis: In the midst of an era of conflict, Oniyasha wrestles with a question he cannot answer.

episodes.title: You Have a Body
episodes.synopsis: Fascinated by the woman's haunting performance, Oniyasha seeks her out and requests to watch her dance again.

episodes.title: You Have Your Own Sense of "Good"
episodes.synopsis: The Kanze Troupe has a once-in-a-lifetime chance to perform for the shogun, but it's an opportunity that weighs heavily on Oniyasha's shoulders.

episodes.title: Differing Scales of Progress
episodes.synopsis: As the Kanze Troupe takes the stage at Imakumano, Oniyasha gains a new perspective on both his father and the shogun.

episodes.title: A Budding Throb
episodes.synopsis: Two rival troupes hold a competition, and the stakes couldn't be higher. The losing troupe must forfeit the shogun's patronage and disband.

episodes.title: Connection
episodes.synopsis: Oniyasha gets a second chance, but he'll have to regain his confidence before facing Zojiro again.

episodes.title: In Between
episodes.synopsis: Oniyasha and Kogane struggle to accept Toku's fate.

episodes.title: To the Other Side of the Bridge
episodes.synopsis: Oniyasha's stunning performance compels Zojiro to concede defeat. Yet the competition continues, and both performers are forced to face their own limitations.

episodes.title: Concealed Feelings
episodes.synopsis: Oniyasha and Zojiro have decided to collaborate, but that doesn't mean everyone is happy about it. Meanwhile, Chiharu struggles with feelings of inadequacy.

episodes.title: A World Overflowing
episodes.synopsis: Oniyasha and Zojiro take the stage for the final round, but the competition will end in a way no one predicted.

episodes.title: The Moon Before It`s Full
episodes.synopsis: Years later, the leader of the Hiyoshi Troupe, Inuo, receives a message telling him to come to Sanjobomon.

episodes.title: Reclaiming Intentions
episodes.synopsis: Burdened by a changing body, Oniyasha returns to old friends and the village he once called home. Perhaps he can find the resolve to move forward there.

episodes.title: Noh
episodes.synopsis: Oniyasha performs with Inuo on stage.

episodes.title: Unforgiven
episodes.synopsis: Battle Spirits rivals Ku and Ibuki have no idea that the tides of history are shifting around them...

episodes.title: Il collezionista
episodes.synopsis: Ku gets caught up in an assortment of schemes when trying to protect a friend from card hunters.
